item.title: Rep. Panetta, others reintroduce bill to help organic agriculture grow
item.description: According to the 2024 Monterey County Crop and Livestock Report, there were 73,551 total acres of land used for organic farming in Monterey County by 177 producers with reported gross sales of $884,921,000. Organic production commodity groups in the county include citrus and tree fruit, table and wine grapes, strawberries and other berries and fruits, broccoli, carrot, celery, lettuce, spinach, as well as livestock.
